title: phaseshift~

messages.description: signal whose phase will be shifted
sets the frequency that is shifted by 180 degrees

body: [phaseshift~] is a 2nd order allpass filter: it keeps the gain and only shifts the phase, from 0 (at 0 Hz) to 360 degrees (at the Nyquist frequency). The frequency that is shifted by 180 degrees is the filter's frequency, and the Q parameter sets how steep the curve is. Adding the shifted signal to the original cancels frequencies by phase opposition.
